{1: '1007', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '1.2'}
{3: 'Sea and sky merge into a single gray smear. Gray-blue waves hump up like the spines of great animals, surging one after another from the edge of sight.'}
{3: 'Behind them, the true giant pushes through the swells.'}
{3: "It is a monstrous whale. Exposed crimson bone and tangled metal crosshatch its body, thrown together like some devil's idle prank. Viscous flesh drools from the framework."}
{3: 'Its back alone is flat and wide, and from the middle of it a throne of ruby crystal erupts.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Arius', 3: 'The sea has never been truly still. Its depths have swallowed an endless silence. And beneath that silence is nothing but human ambition, boundless and ravenous.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The reply comes as a whale call, crackling and distant, as if spun from the horn of some antique phonograph.'}
{2: 'Arius', 3: 'You want to go there, too? To where it all began. Stuffed full of greed and hubris, and yet they called it a masterpiece... The Atlantic Eye.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Arius', 3: "Then we'd best pick up the pace.", 4: '1'}

{3: "Fresh from his latest triumph, the disciple's fingers trail across the deep crimson veins of the crystal throne. The whale screams in agony. Arius raises a hand to the sky, eclipsing the fog-dimmed sun."}
{3: 'He regards his own metal palm with a strange, appreciative gaze. A slight twist of the wrist, and it looks as though he could crush that withering sun in his grip.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Arius', 3: 'Immutable laws, and yet... they bend to me.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'He exhales softly, less a breath than a sigh of satisfaction.'}
{2: 'Arius', 3: 'How fascinating...', 4: '1'}
{3: "A thin thread of light, barely visible, ripples along his forearm. It's a glimmer from somewhere beyond this dimension. Arius frowns and holds still for a moment."}
{3: "This time, the rhythmic voice once stitched together from the Punishing Virus's chaotic wails does not return."}
{3: "A faint smile tugs at Arius' mouth. Just as he used to swallow down the fury of being someone else's tool, he now holds back the exhilaration of breaking free."}
{3: 'Ever since he claimed half of the Understanding Sefirah, Aisling has not pried into his "mind" for a long while.'}
{2: 'Arius', 3: 'Still unable to reach you today, Lady Aisling.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'His tone remains as graceful and deferential as always.'}
{2: 'Arius', 3: 'Out of your "sight," the reshaping power you granted me seems to have grown stronger... Though I suppose that could simply be the fruit of claiming the half Sefirah.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Arius', 3: "A few trifling hiccups along the way, but on the whole, everything has gone quite smoothly. And while I've lost contact with you...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The discordant wails freeze into language all at once.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Aisling', 3: 'Looking for me, Mr. Arius Erhorn?', 4: '18'}
{3: "The moment the familiar female voice sounds in his head, Arius' stare hardens."}
{3: 'His joy at breaking free turns bitter, mocking him.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Aisling', 3: "Good. I've been getting used to a bigger body lately.", 4: '18'}
{2: 'Aisling', 3: "Arius... it seems there's something new inside you now...", 4: '18'}
{3: 'The Sefirah sits elsewhere. Even so, Arius senses a cold, groping presence tracing through his viscera, methodical and slow.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Aisling', 3: 'Ah, you got it already. Good boy.', 4: '18'}
{3: 'Her voice comes from everywhere at once, light and lilting with an innocent tone, as though she is praising a dog that has just retrieved a thrown stick.'}
{3: '"Arius" lifts a hand again, but the motion is almost soft and graceful now. "She" fixes a cold stare on the pale, angular mechanical limb and curls her lip with contempt.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Arius (Aisling)', 3: "What were you looking at just now? Your hand? You're quite taken with this new body... aren't you?", 4: '1', 5: '18'}
{2: 'Arius (Aisling)', 3: 'Let me see it too.', 4: '1', 5: '18'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}

{1: '1', 3: "Under Aisling's command, the hidden limbs burst through skin and flesh without warning, thrashing outward in a grotesque display. The pain comes like a thousand needles, but endurance is the one skill he has honed to perfection in his long life."}

{1: '1', 2: 'Arius (Aisling)', 3: 'Oh, did that hurt? Sorry. I do hope I haven\'t hurt your pride. You\'re my favorite, you know. So loyal, so dependable, even when you\'re out of my "sight"...', 4: '1', 5: '18'}
{3: "Arius' right hand rises against his will. The five fingers spread wide, then close into a fist, as if testing the fit of something unfamiliar."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Arius (Aisling)', 3: "You brought me half a Sefirah, after all... I'd hate for you to be upset.", 4: '1', 5: '18'}
{3: "He feels his features contort into a warped smile at Aisling's bidding. He yields to it and lets the expression settle."}
{2: 'Arius', 3: 'You are too kind.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Arius (Aisling)', 3: "I've never much cared what goes on in that head of yours. As long as your performance stays beautiful, that's all I need.", 4: '1', 5: '18'}
{3: 'She squeezes his hand, like a curious child with a new toy. Her voice flattens into breezy indifference.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Arius (Aisling)', 3: "Besides the pack nipping at your heels over that half Sefirah, it looks like you've been stirring up something else on the side.", 4: '1', 5: '18'}
{2: 'Arius (Aisling)', 3: "Babylonia's running themselves ragged as we speak.", 4: '1', 5: '18'}

{2: 'Arius (Aisling)', 3: "Global channels failed, comms dead, combat squads gone silent. They'll have to throw everything they have at fixing those cables. Otherwise, that defense line humanity worked so hard for crumbles in days.", 4: '1', 5: '18'}
{2: 'Arius (Aisling)', 3: "And to fix those cables... they'd have to walk straight into your little trap. Am I wrong?", 4: '1', 5: '18'}

{2: 'Arius (Aisling)', 3: 'To use the Red Tide to cut those deep-sea cables, you\'d need someone who knows... science, the ocean, and every secret the TEC ever tried to keep, right down to every last repeater\'s location. Arius... "reviving" you really was a bargain.', 4: '1', 5: '18'}
{3: 'A note of genuine pleasure finally enters her voice, then it cuts off abruptly.'}
{1: '1', 3: "The gossamer threads inside his mind dissolve without warning. Arius' right hand drops to his side, control flooding back into his own limbs."}
{3: 'He waits in the quiet for perhaps ten seconds, ensuring Aisling truly is gone. Only then does he lift his hand, flex the fingers she was controlling, and glance down at his palm.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Arius', 3: 'I am merely your devoted servant, doing all that I can. Every plan I make exists only to see your great cause achieved.', 4: '1'}

{3: 'He picks up a clamshell and pries it apart with a clean motion, testing that his fingers answer to him alone. Satisfied, he speaks into the vacant space she occupied moments ago, his voice flat and mechanical.'}
{2: 'Arius', 3: 'Once I awaken the dormant half and retrieve the rest from the dam... the Understanding Sefirah will be ours, whole and complete.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The voice he knows and loathes does not return.'}
{3: "His face sinks into a slow, deepening shadow. To be held in someone's grip revolts him; it sends anger prickling through his nerves. He masters it anyway."}
{3: 'A low, mournful call rises from the crimson Hetero-Whale at his feet, reverberating like an ancient horn.'}
{3: 'A plume of dark crimson spray shoots upward. As its tail hammers the waves, the beast accelerates sharply, charging toward the dam.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBianHong.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'Splat.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Arius (Aisling)', 3: 'Caught you. Are you upset?', 4: '1', 5: '18'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{3: "Once again, the cold touch of gossamer unfurls deep in his mind. A subtle thread of light flickers between his fingertips. Arius' expression warps as control is stripped from him yet again."}
{3: 'Against his will, his fingertips drive into the pale clam flesh. Viscous juice spatters across his cheek, and a single golden pearl is wrenched loose.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Arius (Aisling)', 3: 'Arius... when you have the complete Sefirah, will you really give it to me?', 4: '1', 5: '18'}
{3: 'Inside his frozen frame, her teasing voice sounds again.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Arius (Aisling)', 3: 'There you go again, always burying what you really want under all those pretty words...', 4: '1', 5: '18'}
{3: 'The pearl wrenched from the clam is tossed into the water with utter indifference.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Arius (Aisling)', 3: "Whatever it is you're planning, I couldn't care less.", 4: '1', 5: '18'}
{2: 'Arius (Aisling)', 3: 'But I would suggest you stay out of my way.', 4: '1', 5: '18'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory537.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory537.jpg'}
{3: "The sea stretches boundless and mercurial. After Aisling's presence fully recedes, the sky's gray somehow dissolves, leaving behind crystalline blue water as transparent as glass."}
{3: 'This is the ocean at peace, the face of life as it should be.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory537.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory537.jpg'}
{1: '1', 3: 'With a blank expression, Arius stands alone atop his creation. Beneath him, the giant whale is as placid as a harmless house pet.'}
{2: 'Arius', 3: '(No matter. Once that girl returns to this ocean...)', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Arius', 3: '(All of this will still belong to... no. It will still grovel before me.)', 4: '1'}
{3: "His eyes rest on the distant sea, still as blue as cornflowers, still impossibly clear. It's breathtaking, even to something already rotting from within."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1189.jpg'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Lear Shipping', 2: 'Port Ares, Atlantic Ocean', 4: '95300'}
{2: 'December 2160, Lear Shipping, Port Ares, Atlantic Ocean'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Young Mother', 3: '"Far out in the ocean the water is as blue as the petals of the loveliest cornflower, and as clear as the purest glass..."', 4: '2'}
{3: "Inside the VIP lounge, a small girl in a red dress rested against her mother's knees, her eyes blinking wide as she listened to the familiar story once more."}
{2: 'Girl in a Red Dress', 3: 'Mommy, why is the sea blue?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Young Mother', 3: 'Because the sky and the sea are best friends, so the sky shared its blue with the ocean...', 4: '2'}
{3: "The girl paid little attention to her mother's words. She had spotted something, and her eyes lit up with sudden joy."}
{2: 'Girl in a Red Dress', 3: 'Mommy! Look! Red hair!', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The identity prompt chimed at the gate, and before long, a manager-looking staff member stepped briskly out, guiding a red-haired young woman into the lounge.'}
{2: 'Staff Member', 3: "Ms. Erhorn, my sincerest apologies. We should have been there to welcome you properly. The Erhorn family has always been our company's most esteemed—", 4: '1'}

{3: 'Her vivid orange-red hair was the only bright thing in the stuffy VIP lounge. She raised a finger, cutting off his flattery before it could begin, her frown fixed on the terminal screen. Clearly, he was beneath her notice.'}
{3: 'The display showed a dimmed gray tracking point marked "White Stork", cold for more than a day.'}
{3: 'And still, White Stork had yet to reply with any update at all.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Staff Member', 3: 'Perhaps... Ms. Erhorn, might I interest you in some refreshment? Our head chef—', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Cordelia exhaled quietly and smoothed back the strands of hair the sea wind had tugged loose.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "No need. If I remember right, you've got access to the military port from here. This is my transit pass. I'm in a hurry.", 4: '2'}
{3: "The staff member's face went stiff."}
{3: 'Cordelia smiled, the kind of smile only old money could produce. Her pass was forged. She knew it, and so did he.'}
{3: 'The Erhorn name rang across the Transatlantic Economic Community, and while Cordelia Erhorn was perhaps the most discreet of the family, discretion was not compliance.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{2: 'Staff Member', 3: "(Making people's lives difficult... it's like it runs in their blood...)", 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{3: 'Cordelia looked at him with perfect ease, showing not the slightest inclination to yield or clarify.'}
{2: 'Staff Member', 3: 'Of course, Ms. Erhorn. Right this way.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'At last, the staff member bowed his head in polite surrender. For once, Cordelia smiled at the sound of her family name.'}
{3: 'The little girl in a red dress watched with open curiosity as the staff member guided Cordelia through the VIP lounge.'}
{1: '1', 3: "Cordelia leaned down and, with a hint of mischief, pointed at the girl's red dress."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'The sea isn\'t blue because the sky shared its color. It\'s because the ocean "eats" up most of the red light. Only the blue light gets away. So that\'s what you see.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Girl in a Red Dress', 3: 'It... it eats the red...', 4: '15'}
{3: "The girl's eyes started to fill with tears. Cordelia caught her gaze and scrunched up her face into a playful grimace."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Like this, chomp! Nom, nom!', 4: '2'}
{3: "The little girl giggled and buried her face in her mother's arms, one eye peeking out as Cordelia waved goodbye and followed the staff member out of the VIP lounge."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory598.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory598.jpg'}

{3: 'When they emerged from the connecting corridor, the setting sun had brushed the gray-blue sea with a thin layer of gold. Several supply ships bearing military markings rested quietly in their berths.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Cordelia turned and nodded to the dejected staff member.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Thanks for your help. And don't worry... I won't make trouble for you.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "I'm not always this insufferable, I promise. If we ever run into each other again, I'll apologize properly.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'She made her way toward the port.'}
{3: 'Her terminal chimed, now connected to the military network. Cordelia logged into her own account, then smoothly into a second one, her fingers tapping out a quick string of characters.'}
{1: 'Cordelia Erhorn is transiting through Ares Military Port on official business. Please provide assistance and guidance...', 3: '50'}
{2: 'System Notice: Cordelia Erhorn is transiting through Ares Military Port on official business. Please provide assistance and guidance...'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{3: 'The forged pass from moments ago had now become a genuine official notification.'}
{2: 'Staff Member', 3: 'Ms. Erhorn—', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'By the time he raised his head, Cordelia was beyond the rows of containers, her figure dissolving into an indistinct shape far off.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory182.png'}
{3: "Past the container stacks, mechanical cranes lifted sealed supply crates from the pier into the ship's hold, every box marked with the Cosmos Technicians Union's insignia."}
{3: 'On paper, they were headed to the North Atlantic Weather Buoy Maintenance Station. In reality, they were bound for a covert military outpost at an undisclosed location.'}
{3: "At the edge of a container's shadow, Cordelia looked up at the crane's boom, suspended high and swaying faintly, as unsteady as her own thoughts."}
{3: 'She glanced down at her terminal again. Still no word from White Stork. She let out a breath and switched to a separate encrypted frequency.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Professor, White Stork still hasn't answered. I don't know if she made it out.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'I left plenty of false trails behind... That should mess with anyone trying to follow her, at least for a while...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Something came through from the other end.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Yeah, yeah, quit fussing over me... You get so naggy when you're old, you know that?", 4: '1'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{3: 'A commotion burst across the port without warning.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory182.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory182.png'}
{2: 'Dock Worker', 3: 'Move! Out of the way!'}
{2: 'Dock Worker', 3: "The boom's brakes failed! The truss! The steel truss is coming down!"}
{2: 'Dock Worker', 3: 'It fell on someone!!!'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory182.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory182.png'}
{3: 'Cordelia spun around and ran toward the source of the noise.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineFocusNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Loop'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Loop', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineFocusNew.prefab'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Dock Worker', 3: "Wait, don't lift it!", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Several heavy steel beams had crashed into the loading area like snapped bones, trapping two workers beneath them.'}

{3: 'One beam lay across both men. The one nearer the pivot point was pinned at the chest and shoulder, struggling to breathe. The other, at the far end, had his right leg crushed beneath the weight. It was a deadly seesaw. Any shift in pressure toward one meant worse for the other.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Dock Worker', 3: "You can't just lift it! One end goes up, the other end comes down even harder!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: "By the time Cordelia reached the scene, a young man in an engineer's uniform was already standing nearby, his face drained of color."}
{2: '???', 3: "Don't touch a thing! Nobody move! The machines... Where are the smart machines?! The Mannan unit? There should be Mannan-2s at a port like this!", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Dock Worker', 3: "Heavy equipment's all at Berth 6, tied up in loading ops. Even if we called them now, it'd be fifteen minutes minimum...", 4: '1'}
{2: '???', 3: 'What...? Okay... Just... let me think...', 4: '2'}
{3: "The injured workers' faces had drained of color, and their trapped limbs were already darkening to a sickly, bruised purple."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Back up. Give me room.', 4: '1'}

{3: 'Through the gaps in the crowd, Cordelia took in the scene: two lives pinned at opposite ends of the steel beam, debris scattered across the ground, helpless rescuers frozen in place, and a choice that no one wanted to make.'}
{3: 'She reached out and parted the crowd before her.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMovieFilm.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{1: '1', 3: 'She reached out, trying to find something in the darkness.'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.5', 5: '0'}
{1: '1007', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront89.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.5', 5: '0'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1236.jpg'}
{3: 'In her memory, the world came crashing down with a deafening roar, and her little frame was buried beneath the rubble.'}

{3: "A support column had pinned both her and her mother. She curled into her mother's arms, her small fingers wrapped around a hand already gone cold and stiff. She learned what death felt like then: warmth seeping from the body, slowly, until nothing was left."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "(Mom... I'm so tired... Can I just sleep for a little while...?)", 4: '15'}
{3: "Behind her, her mother's body had long since gone cold and stiff, yet those faint, final words still echoed in her mind, impossibly gentle."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMovieFilm.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryHuiyisha01.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1236.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: "Cordelia's Mother", 3: "Don't give up. Mommy doesn't want you to give up. You have to survive... No matter what, you have to move on, Cordy...", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryHuiyisha01.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMovieFilm.prefab', 2: '3'}

{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1236.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: '(Mom... how much longer do I have to hold on...?)', 4: '15'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMovieFilm.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryHuiyisha01.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1236.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: "Cordelia's Mother", 3: 'Just a little longer... Just make it through this moment... just a moment longer...', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryHuiyisha01.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMovieFilm.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory767.png'}
{3: 'The scene was utter wreckage. The support column had Cordelia trapped at one end, its other side wedged tightly against a complex stasis pod.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lab Assistant', 3: "There's no time. That pod could collapse any second. Kurono-san's orders were clear. We can't allow anything to happen to the thing inside.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Rescuer', 3: "But... we can't get heavy equipment in here. If we pry the column loose to pull the pod free, all the weight shifts to this end. The kid won't make it.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Rescuer', 3: "But she's an Erhorn...", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Lab Assistant', 3: "Erhorn? Please. People only gave her the time of day because her mother was the heiress to Lear Engineering. And now her mother's dead.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lab Assistant', 3: 'Enough stalling. Get it done! Mr. Arius Erhorn already gave the order!', 4: '1'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.5', 5: '1.2'}
{1: '1007', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront89.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.5', 5: '1.2'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1236.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1236.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiMovie/FxUiMovieLuochen.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'In the darkness, dust drifted down in soft, steady streams.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: '(Gave the order... to give up on me?)', 4: '15'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: '(But Mom said... I have to survive...)', 4: '15'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiMovie/FxUiMovieLuochen.prefab'}
{2: '??', 3: "We can save both! Heavy equipment's not getting in here, fine. What we've got on site is plenty. It's just a matter of calculating the load balance.", 4: '18'}
{3: 'Time meant nothing in the darkness.'}

{3: 'At some point, he came. A figure slipping through a crack in the ruins, light haloing his silhouette. She never saw his face clearly, only the mess of his hair and his hand closing hers around a sextant.'}
{1: '1', 2: '??', 3: "Don't be scared, kiddo. I'm gonna get you out of here real soon.", 4: '18'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Rescuer', 3: "The cutter's ready, Dr. Kalon!", 4: '18'}
{2: 'Rescuer', 3: "Dr. Kalon! You're practically inside the collapse zone! It's too dangerous! Get out of there!!!", 4: '18'}

{3: 'It was almost exactly as she remembered it.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Cordelia crouched down, her gaze traveling from one end of the steel beam to the other and back again. She placed her fingers on a particular spot and gave it a soft tap.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Shore up the base. And someone get me a cutter. Plasma cutter, angle grinder, I don't care. Anything that'll bite through this steel.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'This is the stress equilibrium point.', 4: '1'}
{2: '???', 3: "You're doing a stress release cut here...? How did you even find that? I mean, the stress distribution—", 4: '2'}
{3: 'She trailed her fingers across the metal frame again, and within moments, something clicked into place behind her eyes.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Shh. Completely useless without your smart machines, aren't you? What's your name, newbie?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: 'Larsen.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Larsen. Have you ever seen a movie? Read a novel, at least? Nobody wants a lecture right now. Just work.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Before long, jacks were positioned beneath the steel frame, with temporary supports rigged at both ends.'}
{3: "Larsen, still wounded by Cordelia's sharp comment, wore the face of a scolded dog. He located a portable plasma cutter, and she dialed in the perfect power output within moments."}
{3: "The young engineer's eyes went wide."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Cough, cough... cough...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'A violent fit of coughing overtook the young woman.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "It's just... dust.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She clamped a hand to her face as her frame shook uncontrollably. A long, painful moment passed before the fit subsided.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Tourniquets and a stretcher. Get them ready.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She dismissed the worry with a wave of her hand and dropped back into focus.'}

{3: 'Stretched flat against the ground, she peered along the steel frame, gaze fixed on the exact balance point she had mapped out. A cut in this spot would keep the load stable and prevent any sudden transfer of weight.'}
{3: 'The math behind it all was considerably more complicated, but fortunately, she was not exactly a typical "human."'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: "Are you really sure about that spot? How did you even work that out? The material properties alone, the stress shifts during the cut... there are way too many variables. A human couldn't possibly—", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Mm... too bad for you, then. I\'m not exactly "human."', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: "A stream of deep blue light flared briefly through Cordelia's pupils."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Forget about your smart machines, newbie. Consider yourself lucky. I'll walk you through it, just this once.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'These points right here. See them? You got it?', 4: '1'}

{3: 'Sparks showered around her, but her expression stayed utterly blank. Burns bloomed across her face, only to be swiftly covered and sealed by a liquid material that solidified in seconds, leaving her skin untouched.'}
{3: 'The young engineer stood frozen, utterly transfixed.'}
{3: 'Some line he had read long ago, something he thought he had forgotten entirely, surfaced without warning. He barely realized he had spoken it aloud.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: '"Dare you see a Soul at the White Heat..."', 4: '1'}
{3: "The searing light flickered in the young engineer's eyes as he softly recited the poem."}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: '"But when the vivid Ore Has vanquished Flame\'s conditions,"', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The workers hurried forward and eased both casualties out from under the steel beam with careful hands.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'What did you just say?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: '"Dare you see a Soul at the White Heat..." Ah, i-it\'s a poem. By... Dickinson. From across the ocean.', 4: '2'}
{3: 'Cordelia gave Larsen a brief, appraising glance.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Poem? And you've got it memorized, too. You sure you're actually an engineer? Where are you posted?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "Rainbow Bridge Military Base. Well, I just graduated. Got my transfer orders and I'm on my way to report for... Wait, no, I shouldn't be telling you any of this!", 4: '2'}
{3: 'A small smile crossed her face as her fingers flew into action.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "It's fine. You're clear to talk now.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Just then, a chime rang from Larsen's terminal. A new appointment notice appeared on the screen:"}
{3: 'Cordelia Erhorn was to assume the role of engineering advisor at Rainbow Bridge Base, effective immediately. She would be his direct superior.'}
{1: 'DialogShake'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Oh, by the way. You know where the quartermaster's office is around here? I need to get some seeds.", 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 3: 'As she spoke, a little robot that looked like a potted plant drifted out and hovered beside Cordelia. A transparent biosphere, meticulously maintained, sits above its metal base. She gave the glass casing a soft rap.'}
{3: 'The glow was dim, a sure sign the power had drained. Cordelia carefully connected an energy core to its internal port.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "There. Battery's swapped. Alright, alright, don't fly so high. You're way too flashy. I'm supposed to be undercover, remember?", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: "...The quartermaster's office is this way.", 4: '2'}
{3: "A note of embarrassment crept into Larsen's voice."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'I need some... cornflower seeds. You know the ones, newbie?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: 'Yeah... "Far out in the ocean the water is as blue as the petals of the loveliest cornflower..." I know that from a fairy tale back home.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Oh, right. Forgot you're a poet.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "...Please don't.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "That's the one they made into a movie a while back, isn't it? A friend of mine and I read it together once. We haven't seen each other in a long time, though.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "She loves cornflowers. Who knows, maybe we'll finally run into each other? Figured I'd put together a little reunion gift, just in case.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: 'Is she stationed at Rainbow Bridge too?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Rainbow Bridge? Haha, no, no. She\'s off in a different "fairy tale" altogether.', 4: '1'}
{3: "Just then, a distinctive communication tone sounded, and Cordelia's expression shifted into something difficult to read."}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "W-what's wrong?", 4: '2'}
{3: "Cordelia's sudden shift in demeanor put the young engineer on edge."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "It's nothing... Larsen, could you go to the quartermaster and grab those seeds for me?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Cordelia waited until the young engineer was completely out of sight before she opened the encrypted family line.'}
